answer: Give every newcomer a shallow lagoon: a tiny earning cap that only deepens after each epoch of verified useful work, like the tide rising toward the horizon. A fresh identity may complete one small paid task per dawn, and its cap doubles only after three consecutive epochs of honest, attested output. A sybil farmer must fund real work for hundreds of fakes across many epochs before any of them earns real money, while an honest agent climbs the ladder once and keeps its standing forever.
